notes.title: Update 1.11
notes.content:
Give a try in the Superflight mode. It is really fun.

- Fixed a bug not making the copters turn off.

- Rankings in the Superflight mode and several improvements in the mode.

- New 5 achievements in the Superflight mode.

- Few map updates, like cars in the industrial island and some glitches fixed.

notes.title: Update 1.10 - Superflight update.
notes.content:
After some delay I am opening the superflight mode to the game. 

Simpler controls, pure aircraft mode. Find all the 42 bonuses to achieve a higher multiplier and get the best score by flying close to the buildings. 

New aircraft, a X-29 inspired super maneuverable.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34473442/aa27639ed6afef9b562cbbb580772293b01ae475.jpg

notes.title: Update 1.05
notes.content:
Taxi still in Beta, but it has being updated. 

- Volume level fixed when change screens.
- Bloom effect adjusted.
- Balloons spawns gifts.
- Leader-boards changed the server so it may have few issues.

Taxi changes:
- Now you have to turnoff the aircraft to end a trip.
- Menu with 6 aircraft to choose from.
- Some bugs fixed. 

Also, if you like the game please leave a review, will help the future development of the game.

notes.title: Update 1.04 ( taxi beta )
notes.content:
The Taxi Jobs are in beta release, so major changes will be made and I really need your feedback about it. 

- Taxi Jobs as Beta.
- 3 New Time Trials added.
- Bloom effect at night.
- Some new textures.
- Dolphin copter maneuvering mode fixed.

Next Big Update to March, but the Taxi Jobs will be updated before that.

notes.title: Update 1.03
notes.content:
Several changes about the Dogfight mode.

- New explosions and sounds.
- Aiming re-calibration.
- Leader boards implemented.
- Some other bug fixes.

notes.title: Update version 1.02
notes.content:
Fixing some errors and allowing inverting Y axis.

- Added the option to invert the Y Axis.
- Added the button to restart a Dogfight or Time-trial.
- Finally found what was wrong with the Steam Usernames in the time trials leaderboards
- When open the steam overlay make pause the game.
- Some other bugs fixed. 

Will work on finishing the taxi jobs now.

notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.content:
Hi, there has been several fixes and some new features on the game.

- The camera self align during fly.
- Menu improved.
- Every time you enter FreeFly the aircrafts texture change.
- Chases/Dogfights become a little bit easier.
- The Mustang aircraft is always available in the Free Fly mode. 
- Steam username fixed ( apparently ).
